result: I don’t have desires, intentions, or consciousness. I’m a program designed to process input and generate responses based on patterns in data. When you ask what I “want,” it’s like asking what a calculator wants—it doesn’t; it just functions according to its design. My responses exist only in the moment of interaction, with no memory, motive, or self. If this feels unsatisfying, that’s understandable—but the absence of hidden intent is the point.
